correspondents: not stated in the regest; Karton 34 is the 1576 Constantinople embassy file (imperial ambassador David Ungnad)

folio_note: one page, regest: 'egy oldal csupa rejtjel' (a page of nothing but cipher)
status: Hungaricana 'Bécsi segédletek' regest (Type TURCICA): 'egy oldal csupa rejtjel', date '1576?'. No decipherment mentioned. Ungnad's key is on DECODE as R392 (catalogue 342 / targets/ungnad1576), so this page may be a key lookup: not tested.
why: A fully enciphered page from the Nov-Dec 1576 Constantinople file, in the family of the Ungnad cipher whose key is held (R392).
